t: A low-cost RISC-V chip with a built-in helper for camera AI projects.
steps: Buy a Sipeed Maix Bit kit with a camera and screen from DFRobot or Seeed Studio.
Download the kflash tool and flash the latest MaixPy firmware over USB.
Install the free MaixPy IDE on your computer.
Connect the board and run the camera example to see live video on the screen.
Copy a ready-made face detection model to a microSD card.
Run the face detection example and watch boxes appear around faces.
Change the box color or add a message to make it your own.
meta: Open Board. From $20.90. A few stores.
